yplus_fin.note: TARGET was ~1 (resolved wall); prism layers did NOT resolve the sublayer on this thin/grooved high-AR blade. Integral forces trustworthy; transition-LOCATION readout NOT reliable.

convergence.alpha_10_to_16_deg: hit 2500-iter cap, residuals plateau (p 7e-5..9e-4) — unsteady separation steady RANS cannot fully converge; forces are tail-averaged means, wider error bars

tier0_reference.note: k=2 is the fair CFD (symmetry-plane) comparison per verify_candidate.py; k=1.7 is the optimizer's reward basis.

a_lift_slope_gate.conclusion: The DATCOM lift-slope extrapolation to AR 2.66 is CONFIRMED. CFD slope sits essentially on the k=1.7 reward line and 4% under the k=2 mirror line — far inside the 25% gate. The lift side of the induced-drag lever is real; hold (~slope*area*break) is validated.

b_drag_decomposition.result: PARTIAL — collapse real at cruise, fails under load
b_drag_decomposition.conclusion: In the ATTACHED range (alpha<=6, CL<=0.58) the drag polar tracks tier-0 within +/-10% (ratios 0.90-1.07) — the high-AR induced-drag collapse is REAL, and the scored drive/speed working points (CL~0.41 / trim) actually beat tier-0 (peak L/D 18.8 @ CL 0.45). ABOVE CL~0.7 (alpha>=8) CFD drag diverges hard (1.3x -> 3x) as the section separates: the constant-efficiency quadratic cdi has NO stall/separation-drag term. Plus a +24% transitional profile cd0 (section does not hold its Re-700k SK81/Zarruk polar at the needle's 2-3e5 outer-span Re). So the induced-drag 'collapse' is only partial: fine at cruise, badly optimistic under hard load.

c_break_angle.conclusion: CL_max at 14 deg — 2 deg LATER than the 12 deg stall_alpha_deg prediction. The feared early tip-Re break did NOT materialize; tier-0 was mildly conservative and the needle keeps (slightly exceeds) its forgiveness margin. CAVEAT: alpha>=10 cases are capped/un-converged at y+~10, so per the URANS-study convention the post-knee magnitude is a LOWER BOUND, not a resolved value.

d_separation_transition_anomaly.result: no early-collapse anomaly; transition location NOT resolvable
d_separation_transition_anomaly.conclusion: y+~10 (not the intended ~1) means the gamma-ReThetat transition-onset location is NOT trustworthy here — cannot report transition positions. What the FORCES show: drag-rise onset at alpha~7-8 (CD peels off the quadratic) and a gentle CL_max at 14 with a soft post-peak (0.935->0.905 over 14->16) indicate PROGRESSIVE trailing-edge/outer-span separation, not an abrupt LE stall. The feared tip-Re LE-separation collapse was NOT seen in this steady-RANS bench (though steady RANS cannot be trusted for post-knee magnitude).

e_bottom_line.wrong_tier0_line_item: the DRAG decomposition — profile cd0 (no tip-Re correction, ~+24%) and the constant-efficiency cdi=CL^2/(pi*0.9*AR_eff) quadratic past CL~0.7 (no separation/stall-drag term). NOT the DATCOM slope, NOT stall_alpha_deg.
e_bottom_line.survives: Lift slope (DATCOM, gate pass), the induced-drag collapse AT CRUISE, and the break angle (14>12) — the load-bearing, least-controversial claims. A deep high-AR blade genuinely gives the predicted lift and cruise efficiency; the needle is NOT a pure model artifact.
e_bottom_line.erodes: speed/drive magnitude under hard load (CL>0.7): CFD drag 1.3-3x tier-0 and L/D collapses 12->5 from alpha 8->14. The hard-turn efficiency the raw numbers promise is optimistic.
e_bottom_line.release_axis: The tier-0 release axis is a GEOMETRIC proxy (0.6*sweep + 0.4*elliptic_dev) that CFD cannot falsify directly. Its intended physics replacement — the post-peak lift gradient — is GENTLE in this polar (CL sheds only 3% over 14->16 deg), which DIRECTIONALLY SUPPORTS a high release rather than killing it. Low confidence (capped/un-converged near-stall regime, y+~10); needs URANS to close.
e_bottom_line.open_risk_flag_ventilation: NOT ADJUDICABLE by this deep-submergence single-phase bench. A 176 mm deep, narrow, high-AR blade near the free surface is the canonical ventilation/surface-piercing geometry; ventilation could dump the very lift the whole reward assumes. This remains the single largest un-tested risk and the needle can ship only with this caveat flagged.
